rules.selector:
/* Front End hamburger, capsule glass pill (copied from .top-btn), not a circle */
  .icon-btn.hamburger

/* test-folder header control, Section role (Cormorant 300), centered */
  .head-select

/* view dropdown follows the Pill role: Jost 300 · 10px · 0.15em · UPPER */
  .pill-select

/* the drawer is a floating glass panel inside its pane (top 60 · right 18 · bottom 22) */
  .drawer

atment. Layout and control behavior remain owned by pages. */
:where(html[data-maya-surface]) :is(.pill,.top-btn,.inv-btn,.msg-call,.primary,.dialog-actions button,.tabs button,.lead-tool,.lead-cta,button[type="submit"])

/* Strong frost is for navigation and temporary layers, not every card. */
html[data-maya-surface="dense"] :is(#drawer,#outbound-drawer,#clients-drawer,dialog,#lead-inv-modal .inv-card)

drawer glass, never a pill or data-panel fill. */
html[data-maya-surface="dense"] :is(.pill,.top-btn,.inv-btn,.msg-call,.primary,.dialog-actions button,.tabs button,.lead-tool,.lead-cta,button.wide,button[type="submit"])

/* Avoid stacking expensive blur layers inside already frosted content panels. */
html[data-maya-surface="dense"] :is(.person,.stat,.model-group)

/* Outbound: the frontend glass-pill recipe, with a quiet spreadsheet workspace. */
html[data-maya-surface] .layout .campaign

/* v10.13: dissecting status pill, pulses softly while the LLM runs. */
  .status-pill

--in variable (live-computed = swiper-height / 40).
     Minor lines every 1 inch (alpha 0.04), major lines every 5 inches
     (alpha 0.10). A slightly heavier vertical band at left = ruler edge. */
  .op-pattern-swiper

/* ───────── v0.31: Fabrics sourcing, lives in the Brief, clean glass frame ───────── */
  .brief-fabrics

/* v13.53: a gradient-only card can ask Nano Banana for an illustration. */
  .fab-visualize

/* v0.12: button chrome quieted, same liquid-glass shell as the pills,
     no starlight halo, no breathing animation. The window is the hero,
     the buttons sit underneath. */
  .op-dissect-btn

lient list underneath doesn't
     bleed through. The drawer itself uses backdrop-filter on transparent;
     the sub-panel needs its own dark fill PLUS its own blur to feel like
     a layer above. */
  #drawer-settings

/* ───────── v10.15: clients drawer (matches Maya's hamburger drawer) ───────── */
  #clients-drawer

/* Front End hamburger, capsule glass pill (copied from .top-btn), not a circle */
  .icon-btn.hamburger

/* test-folder header control, Section role (Cormorant 300), centered */
  .head-select

/* view dropdown follows the Pill role: Jost 300 · 10px · 0.15em · UPPER */
  .pill-select

/* v13.8: way thinner per Fromsa, one line per tile. */
  .tile

/* v13.87: the whole station edits in place, like a sheet. */
  #adm-mkt #leads-table .lead-edit

v8.9: shared liquid-glass recipe. Any pill/button/card surface gets
     this with `class="… glass-pill"`. Individual rules can still add
     element-specific size/typography, but the chrome lives here. */
  .glass-pill

(visualize / one-pager, inline beside voice bar) ───────── */
  /* v7.2: Visualize, liquid glass pill. Heavy backdrop blur + saturate,
     layered top sheen, inner specular highlight, soft outer shadow. */
  .action-btn

/* v7.2: voice bar, liquid glass pill. */
  #voice-bar

/* v7.2: reference cards, liquid glass. Same family as every pill and
     the drawer panel. Card-internal typography (Cormorant title, tag in
     caps) is preserved. */
  .item-card

igns vs. references. Uploaded inspos do NOT glow. */
  /* v8.2: only the LATEST visualized card glows. .is-vision identifies a
     Maya render; .is-latest is added only to the newest. */
  .item-card.is-vision.is-latest

90% transparent (no white sheen), only a faint hairline
     border to define the edge. The card's corner sits at the center of
     the circle so the handle visually wraps around it. */
  .item-card.inspo .resize-handle

/* v10.2: small action buttons, canon glass chrome. Color comes from
     the border (red for delete, white for stack/dissect), not from a
     solid fill. */
  .item-card .delete-btn

/* Stack button, only meaningful on image cards (inspo) */
  .item-card .stack-btn

/* toast, v10: pulled into the page-1 glass-pill canon. */
  #toast

/* v10: .modal-close now carries the canon pill chrome. */
  .modal-close

a floating round liquid-glass pill that pops OUT of the
     top-right corner. Same recipe as the drawer ×, round, sits above the
     panel edge, not flush. v10: canon-normalized. */
  #garment-image-wrap .viewer-close

/* v7.2: Listen / Modify / Switch fabric, liquid glass pill. */
  .modal-text-btn

/* v10: nav arrows canon-normalized, same recipe as round close ×. */
  #viewer-version-nav .nav-arrow

/* v10: viewer ref chip, canon glass pill. v11.10: one notch smaller. */
  .viewer-ref-chip

/* ───────── modal card (paste / settings / pickers), v10: glass canon ───────── */
  .modal-card

/* v10.2: canon glass pill. Was opaque dark + blue-tinted border. */
  .ref-chip

/* v10.2: numbered badge, glass pill instead of opaque blue */
  .picker-thumb .picker-badge

  #notes-drawer

ing tightened on both axes (8/18 → 3/12) so the pill hugs
